checks.note: AccountSuspensionEventListener.onAccountSuspensionRequested is indeed a synchronous in-memory @EventListener with REQUIRES_NEW and no durable record (only ERROR logs), consistent with the finding, but the crash-loss claim hinges on ModerationOrchestrationService.runArachnidLayer/onModerationRetry, the VideoModerationAdminAlertEvent handler, and the absence of a LOCKED-video sweeper — none of that code is available here (file tools disabled), so the verification caveat cannot be run.

AccountSuspensionEventListener.onAccountSuspensionRequested indeed does an unlocked read-check-save in a REQUIRES_NEW transaction, so this side offers no race protection, but the finding's consequence and its verification caveat depend on files not shown: the User entity (presence/absence of @Version), CoachRegistrationService.verifyPhoneOtp, the upload endpoints' verification gates, and the phone-otp-required config in deployed profiles.

createPlayerProfile unconditionally saves a new PlayerProfile with no existence/idempotency check for the parent (unlike createSelfOwnedPlayerProfile's existsByUserId guard), and the only constraint catch — DataIntegrityViolationException on parentPlayerLinkRepository.save, keyed on player_id — cannot fire because each concurrent request creates its own fresh profile id, so both inserts commit. Could not open CreatePlayerProfilePage.vue (no file tools this session), but per the caveat the backend is unprotected either way.

createSelfOwnedPlayerProfile does exactly the check-then-insert described: existsByUserId at line 91 followed by playerProfileRepository.save with no try/catch for DataIntegrityViolationException, unlike the parentPlayerLinkRepository.save in createPlayerProfile which catches it and maps to ShadowAccountException. With the finding's own verification of uq_pp_user_id, the race loser's constraint violation propagates unmapped.

R9/R10 cover other ShadowAccountService methods; nothing reports linkAdditionalParent's missing ownership/consent check.
